She asked for a gown inspired by Love and Deepspace—and by her in-game partner, Xavier. We designed a piece that feels like a perfect pair to his character: celestial, regal, and quietly powerful. The bodice features a star-speckled navy with soft ombré into lilac and rose, echoing a night-sky gradient. A cascade of layered tulle and organza—trimmed with gilded lace—creates movement like drifting constellations, while the draped shoulder veils add a comet-tail silhouette.

This piece was requested by our client who will use it for a photoshoot —a Caraval-inspired gown echoing Scarlett Dragna, featuring a gilded bodice and antique-trimmed tiers in crimson, obsidian, and ivory.

Our bride asked for a non-traditional wedding dress with mint/teal as the dominant shade and bold purple accents—no pastels. Per her instructions, we built a flat, structured corset and defined the skirt’s structure to her specs, then layered it with airy tulle for movement. Vivid violet lace and 3D florals trace the bodice and sweep through the skirt, creating strong contrast against the cool teal base. The result: a modern, statement bridal look—fresh, fearless, and undeniably enchanting.

Our client is attending a Tangled-themed prom and wanted a gown inspired by the lantern scene—romantic, glowing, and princess-worthy. We designed a layered silhouette in purple and white, finished with gold accents and embroidery to echo the warm lantern light. Enchanting, storybook, and ready for the ballroom.

Our client dreamed of a Tangled lantern gown for prom—soft, glowing, and princess-worthy. We initially suggested touches of purple, but she preferred a pure cream palette with gold accents, and we built the design around that vision. The corseted bodice is traced with gilded embroidery and sparkling appliqués, while layers of airy tulle and organza create a lantern-light shimmer as the skirt moves. A draped capelet/veil and scalloped gold hem finish the look. The result is a warm, luminous take on the lantern scene—elegant, romantic, and utterly enchanting for prom night.

For her debut, she asked for a tulle ballgown with coffee-tone florals focused on the corset. We crafted a soft champagne base layered with airy tulle for light, floating movement, then traced the bodice with hand-placed floral appliqués in warm coffee and nude tones to frame the waist and neckline. The skirt keeps a clean, romantic sweep with subtle shimmer so the floral work stands out. Elegant, modern, and picture-perfect for her first entrance.

Custom-made based on our client’s personal inspirations, this gown was reimagined in radiant shades of violet, indigo, and midnight blue — colors chosen to create a luminous, ethereal glow with every movement. Crafted with layers of iridescent organza and soft tulle, the draping and silhouette to highlight both elegance and fantasy.

Inspired by our client’s prom vision, this gown was lovingly reinterpreted into a soft, romantic silhouette. Layers of blush tulle, hand-placed florals, and butterfly accents bring this storybook piece to life.

Inspired by the bride’s own vision of soft romance and subtle elegance. Crafted from delicate lace and cream-white fabric, this gown was designed to achieve a timeless glow—warm and refined rather than bright white. The floral appliqués and layered details add gentle movement and texture, creating a graceful silhouette that complements the bride’s natural charm. She also opted for both the long gown and pixie version for a seamless change of look throughout her celebration.

A medium ball gown designed for graceful movement and elegance on the dance floor. This piece features a deep velvet fabric that drapes beautifully, creating a rich, flowy silhouette with every twirl. Embellished with delicate pearls and paired with a soft white inner layer, the gown achieves a perfect balance between regality and comfort. Its sleeveless bodice offers freedom of movement, complemented by a matching hood that adds a touch of fantasy and sophistication. Ideal for grand balls, themed events, or performances where elegance meets effortless motion.

A custom high-low gown designed in layered shades of purple and blue, accented with touches of gold embroidery for a regal finish. The gown features a conservative bodice with attached puff sleeves, blending sophistication with fairytale elegance. Crafted with tiered fabrics that create depth and graceful flow, each detail—from the shimmered organza to the delicate embellishments—was tailored to capture both modesty and grandeur. Perfect for performances, themed events, or special occasions that call for a dramatic yet refined statement.

Inspired by a beloved manhwa character, this gown captures the grace and regal charm reminiscent of The Villainess Turns the Hourglass. Designed with a structured silhouette and layered organza fabrics, it features a rich crimson outer layer and a beige satin center panel adorned with intricate lace patterns. The mid-length sleeves are accented with ribbon bows, while the neckline is styled with a choker-like embellishment — a subtle nod to its fantasy inspiration. Every element was thoughtfully crafted to bring a touch of elegance and storybook magic to life.

A simple yet striking red ball gown designed to captivate with its sparkle and timeless silhouette. Crafted with layers of glittered tulle and refined shirring details, this gown achieves a full, graceful volume that flatters every movement. Minimal in design but rich in presence — a true statement piece for grand occasions.

A dramatic crimson gown that transforms effortlessly from a lighter, flowy silhouette into a full grand ball gown. Rich satin and glittered tulle create depth and movement, while layers of cascading skirts—finished with ornate gold lace—glow with every step and twirl. The structured corset bodice is adorned with floral appliqués, jeweled buttons, and a vintage cameo centerpiece, framed by soft puff sleeves and a trailing black glitter cape for added drama. Designed for both comfort and impact, this versatile piece is perfect for proms, masquerade balls, theater performances, or any enchanted event where you want to look like a dark, regal heroine.

A Rapunzel-inspired gown in soft lilac tones, designed to capture that dreamy “tower princess” glow whether in full ball gown or flowy pixie length. Layers of lightweight organza and glittered tulle create a cloud-like skirt that swirls beautifully with every twirl, while the front panel is adorned with delicate floral embroidery and subtle sparkles that catch the light. The structured corset bodice features off-shoulder ruffles, petal appliqués, and dainty crystal accents, balancing support with a soft, romantic silhouette. Versatile and enchanting, this piece is perfect for proms, debuts, fairytale photoshoots, or any event where you want to feel like you’ve stepped straight out of a storybook.
